name: @jakerains/scormplayer
description: Open any SCORM package in your browser, click through it like an LMS would, and leave pinned notes you can hand to a teammate or an AI agent.
author: Jake Rains

scripts.test: node --test tests/server.test.mjs tests/quality.test.mjs tests/webmcp.test.mjs tests/scorm-api.test.mjs tests/qa.test.mjs tests/qa-standard.test.mjs tests/plugins.test.mjs tests/scorm-state.test.mjs tests/setup.test.mjs tests/update-notice.test.mjs tests/releases.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run build:plugins
scripts.build:plugins: npm --prefix integrations/agent run build && node scripts/package-agent-plugin.mjs
scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run build:plugins && npm run build:standalone && node scripts/package-release.mjs
scripts.test:plugins: npm --prefix integrations/agent run typecheck && npm --prefix integrations/agent test
